subject: bia
title: BIA.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 440 (TRF(CW)-12). BIA (bi-aitional) is the subject; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: APPL-DT, SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and INFO-DY. From APPL-DT: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and POL-DY (political dynamics). From PROG-CONT: PART (participation). From POL-DY: CULT-INFO-BS (culture information basis). From CULT-INFO-BS: ATTN (attraction). From SPT-DY: TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From TH-CONT: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation). From INFO-DY: IST-F (isolated focus) and MT-INF. From MT-INF: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics).
